description.value:
"There is no better master of me than myself" Training alone allows you to develop your own style more effectively. When training alone you gain the following benefits:

  • You (A) gain 3 Ranks of Mastery to put into Techniques you know or (B) gain 1 additional Training Boon
  • You gain one Training Boon.

Alternatively you may replace both of those options to gain 1 Technique of one Ki Rank higher than you currently are.
